name: EESystem session – 90 minutes
description: An hour and a half in the same room, equipped with the EESystem, for anyone who wants a longer slot. It goes exactly like the 60-minute session: you stay clothed, in an armchair, on a lounger or on the sofa, with a blanket and water within reach, and nothing you have to do. You can come on your own or in a small group.
whatsappMessage: Hello! I would like to book an appointment. Service: EESystem session – 90 minutes.
